summary: Conditionally performs error cleanup and exit display. When dword_8D3EBC is 1, or when it is 0 and dword_5E65B4 is 1 (console attached), calls sub_5932F3(0xFC) for cleanup, invokes the optional callback stored in dword_8D41AC if non-null, then calls sub_5932F3(0xFF) for final exit display and returns that result. Otherwise returns dword_8D3EBC unchanged (no display path).

operations.description: Gate on dword_8D3EBC: enter the error-exit path only when it equals 1, or when it equals 0 and dword_5E65B4 (console attached flag) equals 1.
If dword_8D41AC is non-null, invoke it as a function pointer (optional registration/cleanup callback).
Call sub_5932F3(0xFF) — final exit display — and return its result.
Blocked path: return dword_8D3EBC unchanged when neither display condition holds.
Error-path entry point reached from callers CRTAmsgExit and ErrorHandlerWithOptionalCleanupThenExit.

unresolved: What sub_5932F3 modes 0xFC (cleanup) and 0xFF (final exit) do internally is not established here.
Identity of the callback stored in dword_8D41AC and who registers it is unknown.
